_readme: L0-DEKEYWORD dev set (2026-10-31). Natural human->AI questions in 12 languages, 6 groups. Used by the uvicorn probe (before/after) and by tests/T02_contract/test_l0_dekeyword_routing.py. NOT read by any code under scp/. 'expect' is the routing CONTRACT, not a model label: natural-language rows must NOT be decided by L0 (L0 must abstain so the semantic layer decides); symbolic arithmetic rows are decided by L0 syntax (no words) as LANE_FACTUAL; no row may ever reach LANE_CHATBOT without dual semantic consensus.
